/**
 * @name Command Execution Analysis
 * @description Identifying command execution sinks to check for injection vulnerabilities.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/command-execution-analysis
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "spawnl", "spawnle", "spawnlp", "spawnlpe", "spawnv", "spawnve", "spawnvp", "spawnvpe"]).getACall()
select call, "Command execution sink found."
findings.hypothesis: Checking for potential command injection sinks in subprocess and os calls.

import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "check_call", "check_output", "run"]).getACall() and
  call.getArgByName("shell").asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
select call, "subprocess call with shell=True"
findings.hypothesis: Checking for subprocess calls with shell=True which can be dangerous if arguments are user-controlled.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Identify functions with shell=True
 * @description Find functions containing subprocess calls with shell=True to understand context
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity info
 * @id py/identify-shell-true-functions
 * @tags context
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, Function f
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() and
  call.getArgByName("shell").asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true and
  call.getScope() = f
select call, "Found shell=True call in function " + f.getName()

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Inspect subprocess arguments in _termui_impl.py
 * @description Inspect arguments passed to subprocess calls in _termui_impl.py to understand data flow.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/inspect-subprocess-args
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "_termui_impl.py" and
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["Popen", "call", "run"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Subprocess call found. Arg 0: " + call.getArg(0).toString()
findings.hypothesis: Inspect arguments of subprocess calls to determine if they are user-controlled.
